retro.learned: (1) On the economy seam a cold review per round paid every time: four BL-1172 rounds each passed their own harnesses and each held a real defect, three of them visible only over many ticks. (3) A walk list built from pending rows must be checked against the items' states first: one row belonged to an item cancelled a month earlier, and was confirmed in error.
